description.text: Main Courses Logistics management, Financial management, Supply chain management, Operation management, Modern procurement management, Project management, International logistics management decision-making model and method, Customs declaration of theory and practice, Economics, Accounting, Statistics, Logistics, Marketing, Customer relationship management, Public relations, Enterprise logistics strategy management, Logistics technology and equipment, International finance etc.

duration.text: The Logistics Management at Soochow University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2500 USD/per year ￥ 18000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number&expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Academic transcript of high school 5.Certificate of HSK HSK level 3-6 6.Additional materials Additional materials may be required
